title: The Fall of Minecraft's 2b2t
summary: FitMC tells how the Nocom exploit let griefers track players across Minecraft's oldest anarchy server, 2b2t, and the fallout that followed.
why: Cited as the original, accurate account of the Nocom exploit, a story of years of player tracking and impressive technical work.

quote.text: it details a story of gaslighting, 3 years of player data, and some really really impressive technical work
